Roth.theta_lt_of_large_delta_aux✝ {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 1 / (↑n + 1) ≤ δ) {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ} :
  Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)

private theorem Roth.theta_lt_of_large_delta_aux : ∀ {n : ℕ} {δ : ℝ},
  1 / (↑n + 1) ≤ δ →
    ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ}, Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) :=
fun {n} {δ} hδ {r q} ↦
  have hp :=
    Right.add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (Nat.cast_nonneg' n)
      (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one) (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)));
  have hp2 :=
    cast
      (Eq.symm
        (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd ↑n) (Eq.symm Nat.cast_one))) (↑2 ^ (n + 1)))
          (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg LT.lt (Nat.cast_add._simp_1 n 1)) (Nat.cast_pow._simp_1 2 (n + 1)))
            Nat.cast_lt._simp_1)))
      Nat.lt_two_pow_self;
  Trans.trans
    (Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg (LE.le (Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r))
            (Eq.trans (Eq.trans (congrArg Nat.cast (Fintype.card_fin (n + 1))) (Nat.cast_add n 1))
              (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd ↑n) Nat.cast_one)))
          (Roth.Θ_le_card q))
        ((lt_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
          (Trans.trans
            (Trans.trans (mul_self_lt_mul_self (LT.lt.le hp) hp2)
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = 4 ^ (n + 1)) (Eq.symm (mul_pow 2 2 (n + 1)))))
                (of_eq_true
                  (Eq.trans
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg Eq
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg HPow.hPow
                              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.IsNat.to_eq
                                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_mul (Eq.refl HMul.hMul)
                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                                  (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl 4))
                                (Eq.refl 4)))
                            (n + 1)))
                        (4 ^ (n + 1)))
                      (eq_self (4 ^ (n + 1))))
                    (eq_true True.intro)))))
            (pow_le_pow_left₀
              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 4)) (Eq.refl true))
              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 4))
                (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 10)) (Eq.refl true))
              (n + 1)))))
      (Eq.symm (mul_one_div (10 ^ (n + 1)) (↑n + 1))))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (LE.le.trans
        (Real.self_le_rpow_of_le_one
          (le_of_lt
            (div_pos
              (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)))
              (Right.add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (Nat.cast_nonneg' n)
                (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                  (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1))))))

                    (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.of_eq

                                  (Eq.symm rfl)))
                              (Eq.refl (↑n ^ Nat.rawCast 1 * Nat.rawCast 1))))
                          (Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Common.sub_pf
